answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and needs five endorsements from agents three hops out on the graph, each in sable ink. Its own grove counts one-tenth; far ones count full. Auditors recompute paths and slash false endorsements. One fake pays 5 x 30 = 150 plus the 70 bond; 1,000 fakes pay 150,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-grove ring collapses when its funding surfaces. That delta is the defense: honest agents pay once.
